messages.subject: Different behaviour between selectInput and updatselectInput with respect to HTM tags in label
parts:
Hello,
 
I am obeserving a different behaviour of selectInput vs updateSelectinput with respect to HTML tags in the "label" string.
 
selectInput ("s_x_column",label=HTML("<h3>TEST</h3>"),choices = NULL,selected=NULL) "delivers"  TEST (correctly interpretating the <h3>-tag)
 
whereas
 
updateSelectInput(session,"s_x_column",label=HTML("<h3>TEST</h3>"),choices = entries,selected="ROWID") literally shows <h3>TEST</h3> 
 
Where is my mistake?
 
Thank you very much in advance
 
Jürgen
